name: Inferno
primary:
The most powerful stream of fire.
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 4.75 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 24 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
